title: Illustrative fuel-shock sensitivity
hypothesis: Illustrative analyst hypothesis: under these assumed responses, repricing partly offsets the modeled cash-flow loss from a temporary fuel shock. This is a sensitivity test, not a forecast or investment recommendation.
checkpoint: Review the next published quarterly fuel expense, passenger yield and cash-flow disclosures against the modeled response assumptions.
falsification: Revisit the hypothesis if disclosed yield and fuel costs show no assumed offset, cash timing contradicts the simplified bridge, or operational constraints make the assumed pricing/capacity response infeasible.
